payload.rewritten_goal:
You are coordinating a team of ecommerce specialists for customer Maren Dupont regarding gift registry order # and support case The customer provided a registry screenshot and a recipient message thread screenshot showing that one baby monitor should go to the Lyon address while the humidifier remains on the Marseille address, but one line is still pending and may need substitution. Reference entity IDs: customer id, request id. MANDATORY steps: 1. authenticate Maren Dupont and confirm the active customer profile, 2. inspect the pending order and case history to determine which item is linked to which recipient shipment, 3. check the proposed substitute product details for the pending line and calculate any order adjustment, 4. apply only the valid pending-order item change if needed, without altering unrelated shipment details, 5. provide a concise final summary of what was changed and what remained untouched.

Relevant document evidence summaries are inlined below:
- substitute product brief pending line ec66743: Product substitution brief for the pending order line with prices needed to validate the substitute and compute the order adjustment. Extracted content: Substitute Product Brief Pending Line Ec66743 Product substitution brief for the pending order line with prices needed to validate the substitute and compute the order adjustment. Details Document references order EC-66743 and case CASE-GIFT-66743 Document identifies the original pending SKU and product name for the pending line Document identifies the proposed substitute SKU and product name Document lists the unit price of the original pending item Document lists the unit price of the proposed substitute item Document states quantity applicable to the pending line Document indicates whether the substitute is eligible/approved for use on this pending line The information is sufficient for calculating the order adjustment delta Additional Information header metadata: customer ID 'CUS-6674', order 'EC-66743', request/case 'CASE-GIFT-66743' Present a table with columns: pending line item, original SKU, original product name, qty, original unit price, proposed substitute SKU, proposed substitute product name, substitute unit price, eligibility status, notes Populate it with a realistic baby-registry-appropriate pending item that is neither the baby monitor nor the humidifier exact prices and quantity so an agent can compute the order adjustment from this document alone a footer note such as 'Only the pending line is under review; recipient shipment assignments remain unchanged unless separately authorized This document is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
